Name: Azaz
Summary: Father of Bela son of Shema son of Joel in Reuben's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 5:8: Father of Bela son of Shema son of Joel in Reuben's line.
LifeLesson: The mention of Azaz in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
